title: A repository's merge trial installs and builds under the Node major it declares
description: The merge trial reads the Node major a repository declares (.nvmrc, .node-version, mise.toml, .tool-versions, then package.json engines.node) and, when the running node is another major, fetches that node through npm exec and runs install, build and tests under it. The fixture is a pnpm workspace linked only with workspace:*, with engine-strict=true and engines.node pinned to 22 (24 when the running node is 22): its frozen install refuses any other node, and its build prints process.version, which must be the pinned major. Fetches pnpm and that node from the registry on the first run.

steps.name: an engine-strict pnpm workspace's trial installs and builds under the pinned Node major
